tool_input.description: Build valid CSV and rejected id list per contract

tool_input.command:
rm -f .tmp/valid.csv .tmp/rejected.txt
head -1 data/events.csv > .tmp/valid.csv
awk -f .tmp/filter.awk data/events.csv
echo "valid data rows: $(($(wc -l < .tmp/valid.csv)-1))"
echo "rejected count: $(wc -l < .tmp/rejected.txt)"
echo "--- rejected ids ---"; sort .tmp/rejected.txt | tr '\n' ' '

sort .tmp/rejected.txt | awk 'BEGIN{printf "{\"rejected\": ["} {printf "%s\"%s\"", (NR==1?"":", "), $1} END{print "]}"}' > submission/answers.json
cat submission/answers.json
hops fg list --json --quiet 2>&1 | grep -i events34b498 || echo "NOT_FOUND"
